title: Migraines and energy
metaDescription: Migraines and low energy support through nutrition and kinesiology — Patricia Smith at Equilibrium in Takaka, Golden Bay, NZ.

blocks.html: Migraines and dragging fatigue can dominate weeks and months. At Equilibrium in Takaka, Patricia works with nutrition and kinesiology so recommendations fit real life — family meals, work, and what your body is signalling — rather than stronger drugs as the only next step.

Sessions focus on listening to the body through muscle testing, then translating that into straightforward food and supplement choices. The goal is practical change you can keep: more energy from the food you eat, fewer guesswork experiments, and support over weeks when needed.
Clients have described fewer migraine days, improved energy, and advice that fitted around household needs — without requiring them to become a full-time patient of every new trend.

items: A clear conversation about migraine pattern, energy, and current diet
Kinesiology-informed checks that guide food and supplement choices
Follow-up as your body settles — sessions can combine nutrition and kinesiology

blocks.html: Patricia Smith practises at Golden Bay Organics (47 Commercial Street, Takaka) and by private arrangement, including online. New Zealand clients outside Golden Bay are welcome for online sessions.
